title: DashboardPlanPreview guards against stale async preview requests via session identity
answers: Why doesn't dismissing an old plan preview navigate away from a newer one?
How does the plan preview avoid racing navigation when multiple RENDER_PLAN calls overlap?
Why does END_PLANNING sometimes report 'The preview dashboard is no longer open'?
body: DashboardPlanPreview (public/app/features/plugins/components/restrictedGrafanaApis/dashboardMutation/DashboardPlanPreview.ts) tracks one `active` PreviewSession object; render()/waitForDashboard()/end()/restoreAfterFailure() all compare `this.active !== session` (object identity, not just planId) before acting, and end() additionally checks `session.client !== client`. This is what prevents a stale/late-resolving render() or a mismatched end() call from navigating away from or clobbering a newer session's state (e.g. a late failure on an older plan must not override the location restore of a newer, successful one). If you touch this file, preserve identity comparisons rather than switching to planId-only checks, since revised plans reuse the same planId lineage but get new session objects.
applies: Any change to DashboardPlanPreview's render/end/timeout logic or to how preview sessions are created/replaced.
